about: Labelled set for measuring recommender precision@10 against catalogue_data/destinations.csv. For each content item, `relevant` lists the destinations a person judges a good place for it (topic fit, audience, and the destination's rules: promotional items are only relevant where promotion is welcome). Labels were written before the evaluation was run.
labelled_by: DRAFT by the AI coding assistant (Claude) from destination names and descriptions; must be reviewed and corrected by the candidate before the score is reported
